gate_note: Promotion gates are noisy proxies; independent evaluation is the arbiter (strength-eval.jsonl, strength-eval-gate3.jsonl, diagnostics-16sim.jsonl). GATE 2 PASSED by the round-14 candidate: pre-declared 3-seed x 200-game suite vs uniform-MCTS at equal 192-sim budget, pooled 600 games, score 0.575, 95% CI [0.535, 0.614], per-seed 0.535/0.578/0.613. Earlier checkpoints failed the same gate (r7 0.5175@200, r11 0.4725@200, r12 0.526@500); per-seed swings up to 0.64->0.45 make multi-seed pooled designs mandatory for claims. GATE 3 (2026-07-24, pre-declared, subject = round-22 best): vs uniform control 0.5792 [0.5393, 0.6180] @600 games -> gate-2 property SUSTAINED; vs frozen gate-2 winner (r14) 0.5317 [0.4917, 0.5713] @600 games -> NOT PASSED (CI includes 0.5). Two arena promotions (r21 0.583, r22 0.625) did not produce significant control-relative improvement; rounds 15-22 at 3.7M parameters read as capacity-limited, motivating the network scale-up. 30M SUITE (2026-07-24 evening, seeds 1_160_xxx, subject = round-24 best): vs uniform control 0.5542 [0.5142, 0.5935] @600 -> gate 2 sustained; vs r14 gate-2 winner 0.5000 [0.4601, 0.5399] @600 -> dead even; two big-net arena promotions again did not translate into control-relative gains after only one generation of own self-play. CLASSICAL BENCHMARK (classical-match-r24.jsonl, scripts/match_vs_classical.mjs, evaluation-only): the userscript's PVS engine at production adaptive settings beat the round-24 best 20-0 at a 160-simulation budget. The classical engine is far stronger than the uniform control that gates 1-3 measure against; score vs classical is the standing real-strength KPI going forward, currently 0.00. OVERNIGHT KATA VERDICT (2026-07-25 morning): after 7 gateless kata generations (rounds 25-31), the classical KPI is still 0.00 (0-30 vs the PVS engine at 160 sims, classical-match-r31.jsonl) and a 40-game diagnostic put r31 at 0.4625 vs r24 (18-21-1) - the lineage drifted sideways without the gate.
